extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, practitioners, and organizations who may submit public comments on the DHS/USCIS proposed rule (e.g., attorneys, advocacy groups, regulated parties)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for submitting public comments on the DHS/USCIS proposed rule amending certain immigration benefit fees, including an announced extension of the comment period and where to find submission instructions and supporting documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Written comments and related material must be submitted on or before March 13, 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The comment period for the proposed rule published on January 4, 2023, at 88 FR 402 is extended. DHS will consider comments received during the entire public comment period, including comments received since publication on January 4, 2023.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow instructions in the published proposed rule for how to submit comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Please refer to the instructions and guidance in the published proposed rule in the Federal Register on January 4, 2023, at 88 FR 402, FR Doc. 2022-27066, for more information on how to submit public comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This extension notice defers to the January 4, 2023 proposed rule for procedural details (e.g., methods of submission, required content/format). Commenters should consult that Federal Register entry for submission mechanics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use docket identifiers when commenting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regulations.gov and the Federal Register use the agency docket number and CIS number to display related documents; include or reference these identifiers so comments are associated with the correct rulemaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify and consult supporting documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting documents for the rulemaking are available (see list; 'See all 271 supporting documents').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review supporting documents (forms, screen shots, OMB reviews, etc.) posted with the docket on Regulations.gov to inform comments. The notice notes delays in uploading some supporting documents that prompted the extension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the official PDF/govinfo.gov for authoritative text
rubrics_metrics.description: This document has been published in the Federal Register. Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FederalRegister.gov is a prototype XML rendition and is not the official legal edition until ACFR grants status. For legal research and authoritative citation, verify contents against the official print edition or the official electronic version on govinfo.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check DATES and public comments status
rubrics_metrics.description: The notice states the comment period extension date and also displays 'Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always check the DATES section of the Federal Register notice to confirm the current deadline and whether the agency is still accepting comments. The status can change (open/closed/extended).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact information for further assistance (including TTY)
rubrics_metrics.description: For further information contact Carol Cribbs, Deputy Chief Financial Officer, U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services; telephone 240-721-3000. Individuals with hearing or speech impairments may access telephone numbers via TTY by calling the toll-free Federal Information Relay Service at 877-889-5627 (TTY/TDD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed contact for procedural questions. Note telephone is not toll-free; hearing/speech impaired persons should use the Federal Information Relay Service number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reason for extension and scope of consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: An error occurred on GSA's eRulemaking Portal (https://www.regulations.gov) causing a technical issue so that the public could not review or submit comments for almost 24 hours; supporting document uploads were delayed by two days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because of the portal outage and upload delays, DHS extended the comment period by 5 business days to March 13, 2023, and will consider comments received during the entire public comment period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document identification metadata to confirm the exact regulatory action
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Citation: 88 FR 11825; Document Number: 2023-03906; RIN 1615-AC68; CFR parts affected include 8 CFR 103, 106, 204, 212, 214, 240, 244, 245, 245a, 264, and 274a; Agency: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, DHS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing or reviewing comments, use these metadata (FR citation, document number, RIN, CFR parts, agency/docket numbers) to ensure comments are directed to and associated with the correct regulatory action.
